errors.name: InvalidOpcode
errors.message: The program contains an opcode the VM cannot execute.

errors.name: ProgramOverflow
errors.message: The program exceeds the VM instruction capacity.

errors.name: InvalidJump
errors.message: A control-flow instruction targets an invalid program address.

errors.name: StackOverflow
errors.message: The VM call stack is full.

errors.name: InvalidReturn
errors.message: A return instruction was executed without an active call frame.

errors.name: DivisionByZero
errors.message: The VM attempted integer division by zero.

errors.name: ModuloByZero
errors.message: The VM attempted integer modulo by zero.

errors.name: InvalidOperand
errors.message: An instruction references an operand outside the supported VM contract.

errors.name: InvalidVariable
errors.message: An instruction references a variable outside the VM variable range.
